title: fix(app-shell): a refused metadata save reads the parsed error, not the raw envelope (objectui#11379)
body:
Fixes #11379
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A metadata save the server refuses is now read off the error `MetadataClient` already parsed, on every transport. Three sites used to re-read the raw `err.body`, which only the REST door fills (`error` a string, `issues` at the top level). On the HTTP dispatcher's shape (`error` an object, `issues` under `error.details.issues`) they found no issues:

| Site | Dispatcher shape, before | After (both shapes) |
|---|---|---|
| `ResourceEditPage` save `catch`, 422 / `INVALID_METADATA` | banner `[object Object]`; issue list `(root): [object Object]`; Save title "The server refused this draft — fix  before saving." (no field) | banner `FIELD LABEL: server message`; Save title names the field |
| `ResourceEditPage` save `catch`, 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` | confirmation dialog opens with an empty list | the dialog lists the server's issues |
| `EmbeddedItemEditor` parent save, 422 | banner "Validation failed (0 issues)."; no field marked | "Validation failed (1 issue)."; the issue lands on the sub-form field |

Each site reads `err.issues` / `err.message` (and the existing `err.code` reads) from the parsed `MetadataError`. The page does not parse the envelope a second time, and there is no new issue formatter. The page keeps its own SchemaForm mapping and its `labelForIssuePath` banner line; only the source field changed. The REST shape and non-validation refusals behave as before.

Landing point: `@object-ui/app-shell` only, as the claim declared. The producer needed no change. `MetadataClient`'s `parseError` (`packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`) already reads `error.details.issues`, `error.issues` and top-level `issues` onto `err.issues`, `error.message`, a string `error` or `message` onto `err.message`, and `details.code` / `error.code` / `code` onto `err.code`. Every pin below builds its error through that real parser from a wire body, so the REST and dispatcher shapes both exercise it.

## Premises measured before changing anything

Each of the three sites was measured red on the dispatcher shape at base `8673402`, through the real component, before it was changed:

- 422 (the card's item 1). The new `serverRefusalGate` pin went red at commit `3c0ae08` (pins committed, page unchanged): `Received: "The server refused this draft — fix  before saving."`. A throwaway probe (mutation through `ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`) found two elements reading `[object Object]`: the banner div and the issue list's `(root)` row.
- 409 (item 2, which the card left unmeasured). Red at the same commit: the dialog rendered, but the server's issue text was not found in it.
- Embedded editor (item 3, which the card left unmeasured). Red at base: the banner read `Validation failed (0 issues).`.

The REST shape and the non-422 control were green before and after the change, as expected.

## Fixture triage

`ResourceEditPage.docEditor-10188.test.tsx`'s refusal fixture went red after the change. It hand-assembled an error carrying `body.issues` and no parsed `issues`, a shape the real parser never produces from that body: `parseError` always sets `issues` when the body has them. Disposition: respelled. The same wire body now goes through the real `MetadataClient`, and the assertion is unchanged. The `serverRefusalGate` harness's own `refusal()` fixture had the same shape and is rebuilt the same way. `PermissionMatrixEditor.packageDoorRereadRefusal.test.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.pageRequiresStamp-11357.test.tsx` also hand-assemble `body.issues`, but they feed sites this PR does not touch (the permission editor's catch, and the publish catch that reads `err.message`), so they were left alone.

## Tests and gates (at `dece548`, after merging `main` at `b4075c0`)

New pins:
- `ResourceEditPage.serverRefusalGate.test.tsx`: 422 on the dispatcher and REST shapes (banner carries the server message, no `[object Object]`, Save title names `offender → visibleWhen`); 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` on both shapes (the dialog lists the issue); control: a 503 dispatcher refusal keeps the plain banner and holds nothing.
- `EmbeddedItemEditor.refusalIssues-11379.test.tsx` (new file): 422 on both shapes (the issue lands on the `label` field; the banner counts 1); control: a 503 shows the server message. This is a new file because neither existing embedded harness drives a save: the preview suite's module mock resolves every save, and its docblock scopes the file to previews.

Runs, each exit code captured before any pipe:
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` (29 projects): exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` on the test config lists all three changed test files.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` plus every suite that imports the touched components (studio-design x2, MetadataService x1, app-shell console x2, apps/console x4): `Test Files 385 passed (385)`, `Tests 4508 passed | 1 skipped`, exit 0
- `check:new-line-citations` (VERDICT 0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `changeset:check`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: all exit 0
- Lint, narrowed and declared as narrowed: app-shell's own lint script form (`eslint`, inline config honoured) over the 5 changed source and test files (the file count comes from `--format json`): 0 errors. The two edited components carry the same warning counts as at base (53 and 7). `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it did not touch. The full `eslint .` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes (seen while working, not changed here, not filed)

- `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`'s save `catch` reads `err?.body?.issues` in its 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` branch. That is the same mechanism. It is not changed because, read in objectstack `metadata-protocol` `saveMetaItem`, the destructive-change gate runs only when `singularType === 'object'`, so a permission-set save never receives that 409 on any shape. Inference from reading the source, not measured; carrier: none.
- The destructive-change dialog reads `kind` / `path`, but the producer's issue objects (`detectDestructiveObjectChanges`) carry `code` / `field`, so each row heads with the literal `change` and shows no field line. The server's message still names the field. Not measured through a public door; carrier: none.
- On a 422 with no issues at all, `EmbeddedItemEditor` banners "Validation failed (0 issues)." and drops `err.message`. That is the same on both shapes, so it is not this card's defect. Not measured through a public door; carrier: none.
